page.overview:
Who is Krillis?

Krillis was a corpulent male Human Sith Lord of the resurgent reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War against the Galactic Republic, he was assigned by Lord Zash to oversee her new apprentice.

Before its removal from the game, Lord Krillis introduced the mission "Advanced Training: Sith Inquisitor" for Sith Inquisitor players who had just completed the planet Korriban in the 2011 video game Star Wars: The Old Republic. He could be found both on Vaiken Spacedock and in the Sith Sanctum on Dromund Kaas, where he directed players to their Advanced Class trainer, Overseer Kryos.
